sentences.text: Rannikon Rakennus & Remontti Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-15 under the industry code 41000, construction of buildings.
First sales are recorded on 2026-09-15, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-09-24.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a coastal word but the registered industry is building construction.
